title: Skin cancer (other than melanoma)
summary: Skin cancer except malignant melanoma (which is 13.29). A) Sarcoma or carcinoma with metastases to or beyond the regional lymph nodes, OR B) Carcinoma invading deep extradermal structures (skeletal muscle, cartilage, or bone).

children.criterion: Pathology-confirmed skin cancer other than malignant melanoma (which is evaluated under 13.29)
Paragraph A (metastases beyond regional) or B (deep invasion)
Sarcoma or carcinoma with metastases to or beyond the regional lymph nodes
Carcinoma invading deep extradermal structures (for example, skeletal muscle, cartilage, or bone)
